fields.name: log-level
fields.description: The log level: debug, info, warn, error

fields.name: log-level-debug-expires-at
fields.description: The timestamp indicating when debug-level logging should expire

fields.name: session-store-maximum-size
fields.description: The maximum size of the local in-memory session store cache in bytes.

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint
fields.description: The endpoint of the OpenTelemetry collector to send observability data to (used for both tracing and logging if specific endpoints are not provided)

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint-tls-cert-path
fields.description: Path to a file containing a PEM-encoded certificate to use as a CA for TLS connections to the OpenTelemetry collector

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint-tls-cert
fields.description: A PEM-encoded certificate to use as a CA for TLS connections to the OpenTelemetry collector

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint-tls-insecure
fields.description: Allow insecure connections to the OpenTelemetry collector

fields.name: otel-tracing-disabled
fields.description: Disable OpenTelemetry tracing

fields.name: otel-logging-disabled
fields.description: Disable OpenTelemetry logging

fields.name: health-check
fields.description: Enable the HTTP health check endpoint

fields.name: health-check-port
fields.description: Port for the HTTP health check endpoint

fields.name: health-check-bind-address
fields.description: Bind address for health check server (127.0.0.1 for localhost-only)

fields.name: http-timeout-seconds
fields.description: HTTP client timeout in seconds (max 1800)

fields.name: account-identifier
fields.description: Your Snowflake account identifier. This can be either the Account ID (UUID format) or Account Locator (shorter identifier).

fields.name: account-url
fields.description: The full URL for your Snowflake account.

fields.name: private-key
fields.description: Select the unencrypted private key file in PEM format.

fields.name: user-identifier
fields.description: The Snowflake username for the service account that will be used to authenticate.

fields.name: sync-secrets
fields.description: Enable synchronization of Snowflake secrets. When enabled, the connector will sync secrets from your Snowflake account.

fields.name: issue-credentials
fields.description: Enable issuing Snowflake programmatic access tokens for existing users. Independent of Sync Secrets: this also syncs the tokens it issues so they can be revoked, but no other secrets.

fields.name: excluded-databases
fields.description: Database names to exclude from sync (case-insensitive). Can be specified multiple times. When set, matching databases and all their tables are skipped entirely.

fields.name: sync-object-resources
fields.description: Sync database and table resources and their grants. Disable to run a users, roles, and role-grants only sync, so no object-level privileges (USAGE on databases and schemas, REFERENCES on tables) need to be granted to the service account at all. Snowflake secrets are database-scoped and are not synced while this is disabled.

fields.name: write-role
fields.description: Snowflake role used for user lifecycle (create, delete, enable, disable) and programmatic access token operations. Defaults to the USERADMIN system role. Set this to a customer-defined role holding only CREATE USER on the account and MODIFY on the in-scope users to avoid granting USERADMIN to the service account.

fields.name: organization-role
fields.description: Snowflake role used for organization-scoped reads (SHOW ORGANIZATION ACCOUNTS, which backs license sync). Defaults to the GLOBALORGADMIN system role. Set this to a delegated organization role to avoid granting the top-level org admin role to the service account.

fields.name: discovery-mode
fields.description: How the connector discovers inventory. "show" (default) uses SHOW commands, which only return objects the service account's role holds a privilege on - full account visibility therefore needs per-object OWNERSHIP or account-level MANAGE GRANTS. "account_usage" reads the SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE views instead, which needs no MANAGE GRANTS at all (only the ACCOUNT_USAGE SECURITY_VIEWER and OBJECT_VIEWER database roles) but is subject to Snowflake's documented ACCOUNT_USAGE latency of 90 minutes to 3 hours and requires a running warehouse.
